newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade buoyant, Unibank rise braked.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade buoyant, Unibank rise braked.

text.p: Share trade on the Latvian stock market was buoyant on Tuesday although the seemingly inexorable rise of Unibanka halted, the Riga stock exchange said.
Total market turnover was 122,881 lats, a good gain on last Thursday's turnover of just over 45,000 lats.
Unibanka as usual made up most of the stock market activity with trading worth 86,339 lats although its price was unchanged at 2.11 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, the other share on the official list, climbed to 95 santimes from 92 on volumes of 11,756 lats.
The secondary list was led by the Kaija fish cannery on business of 8,991 lats amid a price rise to over one lat, reaching 1.11 after 97 santimes on Thursday.

Other active shares were the Daugavpils machine chain factory on trade of 9,344 lats, rising to 42 santimes from 37 santimes, and the Latvian Bridges construction firm, which saw turnover of 3,923 lats but was stable at 45 santimes.
